NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author squashed the history into one commit on current `main`, and also changed the parser to keep multi-line text. The self-review checklist still has an unchecked box, and the PR doesn't mention the other open PRs for this issue.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Commit history is now a single coherent commit. |
| ❌  | Checklist is not complete: "Automated tests verify logic where appropriate" is unchecked, despite the comment saying it is. |
| ❌  | Three other PRs for #19589 are still open (#38098, #39481, #39606), and this one doesn't explain how it relates to them. #38902 was closed for the same reason. |
| ℹ️  | The author never ran the new test locally. CI shows as passed. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the checklist and explain how this PR relates to the other open PRs for #19589.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commit history! The self-review checklist still has an unchecked item ("Automated tests verify logic where appropriate"), so please finish it. There are also several other open PRs for #19589 (e.g. #38098, #39481, #39606), so please explain in the description how yours relates to them, per our [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html).
```
